record.question: In the classification of explosives, the "Category - Z" means:
options: Explosive having a mass explosion risk and major missile effect
Explosive having high VOD, but low gas energy
Explosive having sympathetic detonation with high gap sensitivity
Low explosives having velocity of detonation less than 2000 m/s
record.explanation: Category-Z explosives are the low explosives with velocity of detonation below 2000 m/s.
